conventions: Design review: STATIC_URL or MEDIA_URL covers nothing when it is None, equals get_script_prefix() (Django returns an unset MEDIA_URL as '/'), or urlsplit() finds a scheme or host in it. tests/settings.py leaves MEDIA_URL unset on purpose: do not set it there
Design review: the page's own path, STATIC_URL and MEDIA_URL are compared with request.path; resolve() uses request.path_info

Design review: the finding is stored under the session key mvp_compliance_clear_since as timezone.now().timestamp(), a float, never a datetime; a stored value that is not a number is treated as absent

Design review: the check reads request.user, which loads the session itself. Measure query counts on a document's page, which reads request.user anyway, and compare the anonymous case by status and redirect target
Design review: never assert the session key's name alone; compare the session's contents before and after as a whole
The HX-Redirect header is set by hand on an HttpResponse. django-htmx is not a dependency and must not be imported
One plain class with __init__(get_response) and __call__(request), plus is_reachable(request). No MiddlewareMixin, no process_view, no hooks for subclasses, no helper module
System checks are asserted by id, never by message text. Their messages and hints are translatable
Middleware tests add the middleware with modify_settings or override_settings; tests/settings.py MIDDLEWARE is not changed
docs/enforcement.md uses the spec's words (stopped, let past, kept reachable) and the glossary's; never 'gating', 'blocking', 'guarding' or 'interception'

Repo standards that reviews have missed before: no leading-underscore names anywhere (functions, methods, attributes, modules, constants); line length 88; no compatibility aliases; no test of text content or wording; no test of layout or appearance
A mechanism an experienced Django developer would recognise beats a clever one: no dataclass, registry or settings object where a plain getattr(settings, NAME, default) at the point of use does
Settings are read with getattr at the point of use, as views.py reads MVP_COMPLIANCE_AGREEMENT_REDIRECT_URL
Every user-facing string is wrapped for translation and none says 'compliant', 'compliance' or names a regulation
Every model field carries verbose_name and help_text
Text for GitHub and docs is written for an outside contributor: plain words, no mention of agents, stages or tooling
